items.label: Solar-Powered for Extended Battery Life
items.value: The wirless camera comes with a high-efficiency solar panel（wire length 59 inch）, designed to provide a consistent supplemental power source under adequate sunlight. This significantly reduces the need for manual recharging and supports a more sustainable, low-maintenance surveillance experience. It's an ideal power solution for long-term,wire-free outdoor installation

items.label: 2K UHD Clarity with Night Vision & 3x Zoom
items.value: This camera delivers crisp, detailed video day and night. It features standard infrared night vision for clear black-and-white footage in the dark, and a built-in spotlight mode that activates full-color night vision for more vivid details. The 3x digital zoom lets you focus on key areas like faces or license plates. (Compatible with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks only)

items.label: Flexible Storage Options
items.value: Your event-triggered videos are securely backed up with cloud storage（7 day trial）. For extended coverage, you can upgrade to premium cloud plans (subscription required) or insert a microSD card (up to 128GB, not included) for local recording of motion events

items.label: Smart AI Detection & Instant Alerts
items.value: Receive prompt phone notifications when motion is detected. The basic motion detection works without any subscription. For smarter alerts that distinguish between people, vehicles, and pets, or to set up custom activity zones, an optional subscription plan is available to unlock these advanced AI features

items.label: Two-Way Audio & Real-Time Interaction
items.value: Built-in microphone and speaker let you communicate directly through the app. Greet visitors, deter unwanted guests, or check in on your family and pets from anywhere

items.label: IP65 Weatherproof & Wire-Free Convenience
items.value: Built to withstand common weather conditions like rain, snow, and dust, this camera is suitable for many outdoor locations. Combined with its solar-powered design and rechargeable battery, it offers notable installation flexibility without the need for power cords. A practical choice for homes, garages, sheds, or fences

items.label: Easy Setup for Your Peace of Mind
items.value: Get started quickly with the user-friendly VicoHome App. Mount it with the included kit. This wireless security camera helps you keep an eye on your home, loved ones, or pets, providing added security and convenience
